name: nixlabs-games
description: Nixlabs Games - a collection of hand-built HTML5 + TypeScript minigames, shipped as a Cloudflare Pages site.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name nixlabs-games
scripts.preview:functions: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler pages dev dist --d1 NIXLABS_DB=nix-minigames
scripts.db:init: npx --yes wrangler d1 migrations apply nix-minigames --local
scripts.db:migrate: npx --yes wrangler d1 migrations apply nix-minigames --remote
